title: Flow Perturbation++: Multi-Step Unbiased Jacobian Estimation for High-Dimensional Boltzmann Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2601.21177v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The scalability of continuous normalizing flows (CNFs) for unbiased Boltzmann sampling remains limited in high-dimensional systems due to the cost of Jacobian-determinant evaluation, which requires $D$ backpropagation passes through the flow layers. Existing stochastic Jacobian estimators such as the Hutchinson trace estimator reduce computation but introduce bias, while the recently proposed Flow Perturbation method is unbiased yet suffers from high variance. We present \textbf{Flow Perturbation++}, a variance-reduced extension of Flow Perturbation that discretizes the probability-flow ODE and performs unbiased stepwise Jacobian estimation at each integration step. This multi-step construction retains the unbiasedness of Flow Perturbation while achieves substantially lower estimator variance. Integrated into a Sequential Monte Carlo framework, Flow Perturbation++ achieves significantly improved equilibrium sampling on a 1000D Gaussi

translated_title: Flow Perturbation++：面向高维玻尔兹曼采样的多步无偏雅可比估计方法
translated_abstract: 连续归一化流（CNFs）在无偏玻尔兹曼采样中的可扩展性在高维系统中仍然受限，其原因在于雅可比行列式求值的计算成本，该求值需要经过流层的 $D$ 次反向传播。现有的随机雅可比估计器（如 Hutchinson 迹估计器）虽然能够降低计算量，但会引入偏差；而最近提出的 Flow Perturbation 方法虽然无偏，却存在高方差问题。我们提出了 Flow Perturbation++，这是 Flow Perturbation 的一种方差缩减扩展方法，它对概率流常微分方程（ODE）进行离散化，并在每个积分步执行无偏的逐步雅可比估计。这种多步构造在保持 Flow Perturbation 无偏性的同时，实现了显著更低的估计器方差。集成到序贯蒙特卡罗（SMC）框架中后，Flow Perturbation++ 在 1000 维高斯系统上实现了显著改善的平衡态采样。
tldr: 该论文提出 Flow Perturbation++，一种在概率流ODE的每个积分步进行无偏逐步雅可比估计的多步方法，在保持无偏性的同时大幅降低估计方差，显著提升了高维玻尔兹曼采样效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Flow Perturbation++, a multi-step method that performs unbiased stepwise Jacobian estimation at each integration step of the probability-flow ODE, achieving substantially lower variance while retaining unbiasedness and significantly improving high-dimensional Boltzmann sampling efficiency.
